items.headline: OpenAI completes for-profit restructuring with Microsoft stake
items.summary: OpenAI finalized its transition to a public benefit corporation under the nonprofit OpenAI Foundation, with Microsoft holding roughly a 27% stake. The move reshapes the company's governance and clears the path for future fundraising and a potential IPO.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5 with coding gains
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.5, claiming state-of-the-art performance on agentic coding and reasoning benchmarks. The release intensifies competition with OpenAI and Google in the enterprise developer market.

items.headline: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 model family
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3, touting improved multimodal reasoning and longer context handling across its products. The update deepens Gemini's integration into Search, Workspace, and Android.

items.headline: EU begins enforcement phase of AI Act provisions
items.summary: The European Commission started enforcing key obligations under the AI Act, including transparency and risk-management rules for general-purpose models. Companies face compliance deadlines and potential fines for high-risk systems.

items.headline: Nvidia briefly tops $5 trillion market valuation
items.summary: Nvidia's shares surged on continued AI chip demand, pushing its market capitalization past the $5 trillion milestone. The rally underscores sustained enterprise spending on AI infrastructure despite bubble concerns.

items.headline: Microsoft expands Copilot with autonomous agents for enterprise
items.summary: Microsoft announced new agentic capabilities in Copilot allowing autonomous task completion across Microsoft 365 apps. The update targets broader enterprise adoption and productivity automation.

items.headline: Meta releases new open-weight Llama model update
items.summary: Meta published an updated Llama model with improved efficiency and multilingual support, continuing its open-weight strategy. The release aims to counter proprietary rivals and grow developer adoption.

items.headline: xAI launches Grok upgrade with expanded reasoning
items.summary: xAI released a major Grok update featuring stronger reasoning and real-time data integration via X. The move positions the company more aggressively against OpenAI and Google.

items.headline: Mistral announces new flagship model and enterprise tools
items.summary: Mistral unveiled an updated flagship model alongside enterprise deployment features emphasizing on-premise and sovereign AI. The release strengthens Europe's independent AI offerings.

items.headline: OpenAI debuts new ChatGPT agent features
items.summary: OpenAI rolled out expanded agentic features in ChatGPT enabling multi-step task execution and tool use. The update aims to make AI assistants more autonomous for everyday and work tasks.
